answer: Atlas heartbeat bond blocks fake identities: each identity locks 70 credits in the atlas. Each epoch the beacon pings a random slice; agents answer in 10 minutes with a heartbeat signal. The signal is the bridge from claim to compute; the atlas publishes it. Rented heartbeats cannot be re-signed; a miss burns the bond. Heartbeats cost 45: 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep full share.
